tagline: Global IT consulting and solutions provider transforming financial services through AI-driven digital innovation
hero_kpi_rationale: CLPS positions generative AI as the central driver of its transformation, with concrete projects such as Nibot in the HKMA sandbox, marking a key advancement in AI adoption for banks.

kpis.name: Share of deals including AI features
kpis.explanation: Percentage of new IT deals that integrate generative AI or advanced automation tools.
kpis.description: The launch of Nibot, a proprietary AI agent tested in the HKMA's GenA.I. Sandbox, demonstrates that CLPS is at the forefront of AI integration in financial services.
kpis.signal: CLPS integrates AI directly into its client solutions (e.g., Nibot), a strong signal of early adoption.

kpis.name: Customized IT solutions revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from customized projects in AI, RPA, and system modernization.
kpis.description: Driven by Nibot and banking system modernization, this segment is the new growth engine despite a low initial base.
kpis.signal: Explosive growth of +135%: the strategic pivot toward high-value-added solutions is paying off.

kpis.name: Revenue outside mainland China
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated outside mainland China, particularly in Asia-Pacific and the United States.
kpis.description: The international expansion strategy is delivering results, with strong growth in APAC and the U.S. (x2).
kpis.signal: 63% growth: geographic diversification is accelerating, reducing reliance on a single market.

kpis.name: Gross margin
kpis.explanation: Portion of revenue that remains after deducting direct costs.
kpis.description: Gross margin declined slightly despite growth, due to the reclassification of R&D costs to cost of sales.
kpis.signal: Stable margin despite transformation: a sign of cost control.

kpis.name: Operating margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin improved from 0.2% to 0.7%, driven by reduced sales and marketing expenses.

kpis.name: R&D (% revenue)
kpis.explanation: Share of revenue invested in research and development.
kpis.description: R&D as a percentage of revenue declined sharply, but this reflects a shift of personnel to client delivery, not disengagement.
kpis.signal: Decline in reported R&D, due to reclassification to production costs.

kpis.name: Number of ongoing IT projects
kpis.explanation: Total number of IT projects underway or delivered during the period.
kpis.description: The number of IT projects increased from 20 to 35, reflecting accelerated activity and improved execution capacity.
kpis.signal: Sharp increase in project count: a sign of rising client demand.

kpis.name: Total assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €0.11B in the latest year

kpis.name: Customized IT solutions revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from customized projects in AI, RPA, and system modernization.
kpis.description: Driven by Nibot and banking system modernization, this segment is the new growth engine despite a low initial base.
kpis.signal: Explosive growth of +135%: the strategic pivot toward high-value-added solutions is paying off.

kpis.name: Revenue outside mainland China
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated outside mainland China, particularly in Asia-Pacific and the United States.
kpis.description: The international expansion strategy is delivering results, with strong growth in APAC and the U.S. (x2).
kpis.signal: 63% growth: geographic diversification is accelerating, reducing reliance on a single market.

risks.title: Intense competition in the IT market
risks.score_rationale: The risk is at the top of the 'Risks Related to Our Business' section with strong language ('intense competition', 'persist and intensify'). The trend is stable but critical, and the 'Competition' category is central to CLPS's business model.

risks.title: Dependence on a few large clients
risks.score_rationale: Explicit mention of revenue concentration on a small number of key clients. The language is concerning ('significant portion', 'could reduce our revenues'). Recurring risk, high position in the document, high weight for the business model.

risks.title: Difficulty attracting and retaining talent
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned multiple times with strong language ('intense competition for highly skilled personnel', 'negatively affected'). It is linked to growth and operational capacity. Trend is stable but critical.

risks.title: Dependence on executive management efforts
risks.score_rationale: The text emphasizes that success depends 'substantially' on executive management. Strong language, structural risk, high position in the document. Trend is stable.

risks.title: Rapid technological changes
risks.score_rationale: Strong language ('rapid changes in technology'), central risk for the IT sector. High position in the text, trend stable but critical. 'Technology' category is essential for CLPS.

risks.title: Cybersecurity risks
risks.score_rationale: Explicit mention of risks related to unauthorized disclosure of confidential information and network vulnerabilities. Alarming language ('substantial damages', 'security risks'). Trend reinforced by uncertainties around Chinese law.

risks.title: Challenges related to rapid growth
risks.score_rationale: The risk is at the top of the risk factors with strong language ('significant strain', 'materially and adversely affect'). Trend is rising with geographic expansion. 'Industrial' category is central.

risks.title: Uncertain Chinese regulation
risks.score_rationale: The text mentions 'substantial uncertainties' regarding cybersecurity law and other regulations. Strong language, high position, high impact on operations. Trend is rising.

ai_positioning.summary: CLPS positions itself as an active integrator of generative AI in financial services, developing proprietary AI agents and modernizing legacy systems. The company does not position itself as a model provider, but as an enabler of practical adoption.
evidence: Deployment of Nibot, a proprietary AI agent, in the HKMA's GenA.I. Sandbox
Modernization of a 30-year-old legacy banking system with 70% automation
134.7% growth in revenue from customized IT solutions integrating AI
